title: About Display ads and the Google Display Network - Google Ads Help

facts.fact: Google's own page says Display campaigns can reach people worldwide across 35 million websites and apps, plus Google-owned properties such as YouTube and Gmail.
facts.quote: Display campaigns can reach people worldwide across 35 million websites and apps, and on Google-owned properties (YouTube and Gmail).

facts.fact: Google's own page says the Display Network helps advertisers reach people as they browse millions of websites, apps, and Google-owned properties.
facts.quote: The Display Network helps you reach people as they browse millions of websites, apps, and Google-owned properties (such as YouTube and Gmail).

facts.fact: Google states that existing Smart Display campaigns migrated into the unified Display campaign structure without any action required from the advertiser.
facts.quote: Any existing Smart Display campaigns in your account will have migrated to this unified Display campaign structure without any action needed on your part.

facts.fact: Google states that the migration of Smart Display campaigns into the unified Display campaign structure shouldn't cause any fluctuations in campaign performance.
facts.quote: This migration shouldn't cause any fluctuations in your campaign's performance.

facts.fact: Google defines Smart bidding as AI-driven bidding that optimizes for conversions or conversion value in each and every auction.
facts.quote: Bidding that uses AI to optimize for conversions or conversion value in each and every auction.
